answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 44745 Country: India Title: Nikah Question: I am 24 year old and BE degree holder I do not have job. So my financial condition is not good. I am not able to marry but I cannot control my excitations. Please suggest me what to do in this situation. Answer ID: 44745 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 594/594/M=1434) Keep yourself away from the scenes which elicit sexual desire. Keep on fasting. And keep on searching any job. Also try to marry as soon as possible. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
